title: Depth-test + native_tri_depth oracle (saturated split)
purpose: Render a full-screen white floor at z=0.5, then a blue wall covering the bottom half at z=0.0 (closer). With LEQUAL depth test the wall wins over the floor in the bottom half. Captures post-flip front buffer; expected = top half white, bottom half blue. Saturated 0/255 colors only — byte-exact across renderers regardless of any display-side gamma table. Catches the SC2 'floor disappearing' symptom plus depth-test/depth-write/Y-mirror regressions in the native triangle-depth path. (Earlier v0.1 spec used an 8x8 colored grid + gray wall in 3D camera space; redesigned to the current 2-quad saturated split because intermediate per-cell colors get gamma'd at display scan-out, breaking byte-exact comparison.)
